bosses.name: Nek'zali the Soulcoiler
positioning: Pull at the entrance and face the boss away from the raid
The Soulcoil Well sits in the middle; Restless Amani walk to it from the sarcophagi on the sides
Essence Rend targets step to the side of the room before the dispel so the Latent Cultist puddle lands out of the way
In the intermission, stay out of the side Soul Transfer beams; melee group-soak Hungering Pyre
everyone: Nothing may reach the well: each add that does gives the boss energy and triggers raid-wide Soulcoil Rite
At 100 energy the boss enrages with Uncoiled Rage, so energy is the real timer
Dodge Anguished Echoes circles during Soulcoil Ignition, and step out of Latent Cultist explosions
tank: Tank from 30 or more yards so Possession Barrage spirits lose damage on the way
Swap on Hollowing Strikes around 30 to 40% reduced healing
healer: Magic dispel Essence Rend once the target is at the side
Save cooldowns for Soulcoil Ignition, ideally with no Ritual Burn stacks left
Phase 2 Uncoiling ticks on the raid until the boss dies
damage: Strip the Restless Amani's magic-only absorb with magic damage, then kill them before the well
Clean up corpses in Stage One: Vessels revive as empowered adds in the intermission
Kill both Echoes of Jawae to end the intermission; use Hero and cooldowns in Phase 2
mythic: A Drowned Echo spawns in the well six times; assign two teams of 3 damage and 1 healer to kill it
Interrupt Soulcoiler's Curse or everyone in the well is ejected
Stop casting before Invoke: it interrupts and silences you
Revive Vessels one at a time; several together is heavy raid damage

bosses.name: Entombed Sentinels
positioning: Keep the two golems 40 or more yards apart at all times, one per side
Split the raid into two equal teams, one per golem; the red side starts in a corner so puddles go along the wall
Teams and tanks swap sides after every intermission to drop their marks
everyone: Within 40 yards of each other the golems take 99% less damage
Your side's mark stacks every 5 seconds while you stay near that golem
In the intermission, touch one partner so your combined green orbs equal exactly 4, or you explode with Cultivated Burst
Keep both golems' health even: the weaker one heals to match at each intermission
tank: Green tank: Empowering Slam stacks on the same target, so swap
Red tank: swap on Bloodvenom Injection and walk to a safe spot before it expires, since expiry drops a huge puddle
healer: Dispel Blighted Blood at the room edge so its pool lands outside the play space
Don't dispel on cooldown
damage: Green side: kill Venom Coagulation first and pop Toxic Droplets, one or two each
Dodge Living Venom both ways
Red side: group-soak Unstable Miasma, then spread
mythic: Shifting Protovenom marks 8 players: two marked players touching clears both, touching anyone else explodes
Toxic Droplet over-soaks, the droplet lines, and short Unstable Miasma soaks are all lethal
Place Blood Venom puddles on a set pattern so the room lasts
Balance boss health by moving players, not by stopping damage

bosses.name: The Lost Explorers
positioning: Only two turtles may be within 30 yards of each other; all three together are immune
Place Gebbo's bomb at the room edge
Spread from Epu's Blink Nova target so she blinks farther away
Jump on a Bouncy Mushroom to ride over the Blast Wave
everyone: Feed a Disgusting Fish from the crates to reset Mor'zahi's Final Ascension; you get three
A fourth Final Ascension is the hard enrage
Every Mighty Thud mark needs a soak group
Interrupt Icebound Flames
Clear your Frostfire debuff by stepping into the opposite patch before the next set
Each explorer enrages when another dies, so kill them close together
tank: Swap on Shredding Shards (Epu) and Steady Strikes (Nema)
Keep only two turtles in cleave range as they move
healer: Malevolent Presence ticks all fight
Each fish feed hits the raid with Fishy Feedback and a DoT
Dispel Icebound Flames if a kick is missed
damage: Pop every crate before 25 seconds or it hits the raid; crates give the fish
If you must stagger kills, go Gebbo, then Nema, then Epu
mythic: Crate pops hit the whole raid with a bleed: assign one popper and keep stacks low
Feed with about 4 seconds left on Final Ascension, in the order Gebbo, Epu, Nema
Every Blink Nova goes at least 20 yards from melee
Bait Shell Spin to the room edge

bosses.name: Vashnik the Malignant
positioning: The boss drinks from the two fountains nearest him, so where the tank parks him decides the fight
Simplest plan: tank him between the Shadow and Fire fountains
Plague Wave runs along the four cardinal lines, so Plague Froth targets stand off those lines
everyone: Each Imbibe at 100 energy hits the raid and adds a permanent Toxic Vapor stack: that's the soft enrage
Kill every venom before it reaches the central pool, and on spawn before it hardens
Stay within 6 yards of a landing Catalytic Bile, but don't stack the whole raid on one
tank: Swap after every Dripping Fangs
One tank walks the boss to the planned fountain pair before each Imbibe and calls it
healer: Use cooldowns for Imbibe
Siphoning Infection stops healing; Stygian Infection absorbs healing but can be healed through
Stagger Exploding Infection dispels, and hold them if the raid is low
damage: Blood adds split when they die; Shadow adds die twice through their absorb
Grip or crowd control one Burning Venom and kill them one at a time, never together
mythic: Tank next to the shadow fountain and stay in that section
Three Burning Venom spawn: banish one and kill it last
Malignant Totems can only be cleared by aimed Plague Froth waves; one left at Imbibe hurts, two usually wipe

bosses.name: Sszorak
positioning: Tank the boss at the platform edge with the raid behind him in two soak groups
Mark the possible wind tunnel spots and drop cysts opposite the tunnels that will fire
In the intermission, pixel stack in the middle so the wind pushes you into the cyst
everyone: Avoid Tempest tornadoes and Caustic Residue pools
Venomous Surge targets leave a Viscous Cyst where they stand
During Raging Crosswinds, collide with another launched player
tank: Taunts work mid-combo: swap between Ravage casts and take them at the edge
healer: Ula'tek's Presence drains the raid all fight; a fifth healer helps
Coordinate knockback immunities so collision partners aren't stranded
damage: Mutilate needs at least 5 soakers; alternate two soak groups and never soak twice in a row
Dig In makes the boss take 30% more damage: that's the burn window
mythic: Serpent's Fury: 14 players stack in the red circle to reset his energy; at 100 he becomes lethal
After the stack, spread at once for Virulence and use a personal every other set
Crosswinds gain four lines; pre-assign classes without a reliable cancel

bosses.name: The Twin Fangs
positioning: The serpents can't move, so spread loosely around them
Drop Coiling Ichor circles along the room edge
When they Submerge and swap sides, cross the Vile Flood beam early; behind it is safe
everyone: Ten Eternal Venom stacks kill you; green effects add stacks and only Ravenous Feast removes one
Soak every Caustic Globule with one player, or it stacks the whole raid
Point your Spawn of Vexhul's spit away from the raid
tank: Trade serpents on Caustic Deluge and Stone Breaker stacks
Stay in range of your serpent so the range-check spells never fire
healer: Toxic Fumes ticks all fight
Kill both serpents close together: the survivor gains stacking damage
Hero/Lust on pull
damage: Two-target damage shines here
Use three Ravenous Feast soak groups of 7 or more; no group soaks twice
Both must die before the third Submerge
mythic: Globules get Barbed Bulwark, which any crowd control removes: use AoE stuns and fears
Interrupt every Visceral Burst from the ten Broodlings; more than one getting through usually wipes
Feast soaks need at least 4 each; fully absorb the Tainted Blood founts

bosses.name: The Coiled Altar
positioning: Stay stacked behind the boss and return to that formation every phase
Pile orbs in the middle for the Sever tank to clear
Guillotine soaks: two alternating groups go to the corner marker with the target
In Phase 2, move to the Spiritcackle add on the far side; stand near the middle for the 0% knockback
everyone: Drop orbs into the middle pile; orb carriers don't stack with anyone
AoE free Dreadmarch players and grip back anyone drifting to the edge
Gloombomb targets spread, then collect the Soul Fragments within 15 seconds
Kill both bosses close together
tank: Aim Sever through the orb pile and swap on stacks
Swap on Soul Sever and Blighted Sever stacks; Soul Sever also clears the kited ghosts
healer: Poison dispel Venomfang
Clear only as many orbs as healers can cover
Use raid cooldowns when Zul'jan hits 0% and detonates the remaining orbs
damage: Kick Wail of Terror and kill both Spiritcackle adds before 100 energy
Burn Malacrass's Eternal Nightfall shield to stop it
In the intermission, Hero and burst Zul'jan, who takes double damage
mythic: Purple orbs must never touch other orbs; clear every Virulent Mutation before the next Toxic Deluge
Two Gloombombs break each Spiteful Soulcoiler's shield
Ghosts must never touch each other
Push Phase 2 within seconds of the Soul Sever that clears ghosts

bosses.name: Ula'tek
positioning: Split into two equal groups before the pull for Spectral Coils and the Phase 2 sides
In Phase 1, move to the side opposite the wing she pulls back for Caustic Waves
When she resurfaces at the bubble spot, the tank must be there at once
In Phase 3, melee stay on the boss platform and ranged sit to its left; leave it before Circling Prey breaks it
everyone: Keep green damage off eggs and egg carriers or they hatch Vipers
Soak Spectral Coils in your group
Dodge the Mephitic Thrash tail sweep and Virulent Spit
Leech Serpent's Bite before it calcifies, then spread for Volatile Purge
tank: Stay in melee for Mother's Wrath and swap on Stone Venom stacks
Always keep someone on the tail
Swap during waves or casts, never on an open global
healer: Necrotic Vapors grows over the fight
Vipers' Putrid Membrane hits the raid when hatches go wrong
damage: Phase 2: kill the Doomscale Warden in the corridor, feed every egg to the Cauldron (big one last), then kill the Weakened Doomscale
Break Grasping Fangs tethers two at a time
Phase 3: kill each Blightscale Shrieker before 2 Acidic Expulsion stacks and kick Vicious Echoes
mythic: Egg carriers must never come within 3 yards of each other
Everyone stands inside the bubble when Fester Burst goes off
Enraged adds gain double haste and damage: kill them fast
Use Hero as you land back on the main platform after Phase 2

bosses.name: Nymrissa Wavecaller
positioning: Bring the boss to the biggest Shorerunner spawn; ranged handle the single spawns
Run to the gap in the Swirling Whirlpools and stack there
Don't stand where Pop! knocks you into the water
Drop Frost Orbs away from the bubble and the raid's paths
everyone: Stop every Shorerunner before it reaches the Alluring Bubble; any crowd control works
Soak Frost Orbs in a planned order
tank: Swap on Water Jet stacks
Aim Water Jet to wash away Lingering Frost
healer: Plan a cooldown for Pop!
Keep Abyssal Rain from overlapping Pulsing Tides or Pop!
damage: Bubblefin Berserkers are top priority the moment they appear
mythic: Kill each Bubblefin Frostscale first: its shield protects nearby murlocs
Soaking a Frost Orb hits the raid, so spread the soaks out in time

bosses.name: Kith'ix
positioning: Keep every add at least 25 yards from Kith'ix, or it takes much less damage
Drag the Venomous Hulk onto the Voidweaver, which can't move, and stack the raid there
Point Venom Roar away from the raid
In the intermission, stand in Liadrin's light in the middle
everyone: Grab a Light's Embrace mote before each Extinguish, or use an immunity
Kill every add and egg before 100 energy
Stay under 5 Nullify stacks
Kill the boss before the 8th Eightfold Eclipse
tank: Swap on every Dark Devastation
With Negation, touch a Null Gate before it expires
Place Voidscars on the planned markers
healer: Heal off Abyssal Grasp absorbs within 8 seconds
Dispel feared players only once they're away from the raid
damage: Kill the Voidweaver first; Nightfall keeps growing
Grip Bomber Beetles onto the Hulk one at a time
Break Mindstinger eggs before they hatch
Use Hero and every cooldown in Phase 2's Luminous Grace window
mythic: Nullify kills at 3 stacks instead of 5
Negation lasts 12 seconds and tanks clear 3 Null Gates
Beetles and their explosions leave more eggs
